subject: general
question: What is the function of the compression spring in a 2/2-way directional control hydraulic valve?

options.text: To increase the pressure at working port
To move the spool to the actuated position
To return spool to the normal position

solution:
The correct answer is __To return spool to the normal position.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Compression spring__ is used in 2/2-way directional control hydraulic valves to return the spool to its normal position.
 
• When the actuating force is removed, the compression spring ensures that the spool returns to the default or rest position.
 
• This functionality is critical for the proper operation and fail-safe mechanism of the valve.
 
• The spring helps maintain the valve's default state in the absence of external force.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Directional Control Valves:**

 
 
• These valves control the flow of hydraulic fluid in a hydraulic system.
 
• The 2/2-way valve indicates two ports and two positions of the spool.
 
 
 
• **Spool Actuation:**
 
 
• The spool can be actuated manually, electrically, or pneumatically to change the flow direction.
 
• When actuated, the spring ensures the spool returns to its default position.
